summary:
Stale re-validation of SL-082 at 160f400. Since my attempt-1 pass at cd235ca, the only change is T-008 in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1: four new rows in its bad-value table and a rewritten comment. `git diff --stat cd235ca HEAD -- src tests docs eng` shows only that file. src is unchanged, so the published exe in artifacts/publish (written 10:28:05, 139,902,616 bytes, after cd235ca's 10:00:40 commit) is still current.

What I re-ran:
- T-008 passed all 8 values in 40 s. Each launch ended with 0xE0434352, wrote no report, and left one refusal line. The four new rows ('folder1|2|x', 'folder1|2|18', '|2|995', 'a\b|2|995') each got their own reason.
- Each of the four new regexes matches only its own refusal line among the 8 refusals and the armed line. So O-017 is discharged in the tree: the empty-name, path-separator, error-18 and non-numeric-error refusals are now guarded against regression.
- Fitness: all 63 rules hold.
- The full `WindowCases.ps1 -Case All` ran all 48 cases in 937 s and exited 1. 47 passed, including T-007 and T-008. B-006 failed one check, 'the second scan started (ScanningPanel set Visible)', in its first sub-case, where the root is moved away before the second scan. The hook log shows why: the second scan's failure ending arrived 13 ms after 'acted', before the hook sampled 'started' (logged scanning=False outcome=True). The check asserts a moment that did not last, and this run was slower than attempt 1's (937 s against 652 s). B-006 then passed 3 out of 3 runs on its own.
- I count B-006 as a timing race in the harness, not caused by this slice. No src changed since attempt 1, when -Case All passed 48/48. The failing sub-case fails at the root, before any listing page, so it never reaches the failpoint. SL-043's code review already recorded that this B-006 ordering is 'a race and not a guarantee'. I did not run an A/B against uat.

A pre-existing weakness from attempt 1, not this attempt: T-008's error-0 regex (`.*\(Parameter 'win32Error'\)`, unanchored) also matches the error-18 line. It does not hide a refusal regression, because an accepted value would write a report and exit 0, and the exit and no-report checks would fail. It only fails to pin error 0's exact reason.

No loop: build attempt 2 was sent back once, by code review, to close O-017. It did that and nothing else. The bug report was only a title. As in attempt 1, I assumed what build-check, design and code review agreed on: the Core scanner-level test already exists (TopLevelRowTextTests), so only the seam and the window case were owed.

Leftover folders in %TEMP%\fsa-window-cases (16, the latest created 11:33 and 11:40) all predate my runs, which started around 11:41. I left them alone. No FsAnalyser.App process is left running, and the worktree holds only the pre-existing .taad metadata changes.

checks.what: What changed since attempt 1's validated head
checks.command: git diff --stat cd235ca 160f400; git diff --stat cd235ca HEAD -- src tests docs eng; git diff cd235ca 160f400 -- tests/window/WindowCases.ps1
checks.evidence: Only tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 changed (10 insertions, 4 deletions), plus .taad metadata. The change is T-008's comment and four new $bad rows. No src, hook or docs change.

checks.what: The published exe and hook are current for the tree
checks.command: Get-Item artifacts/publish/FsAnalyser.App.exe, artifacts/window-hook/FsaWindowHook.dll; git log -1 --format=%cI -- src
checks.evidence: The exe was written 2026-09-29T10:28:05, 139,902,616 bytes (the file attempt 1 published). The last src commit is cd235ca at 10:00:40. The hook was rebuilt at 11:32:10, and WindowCases' Update-Hook reported it up to date.

checks.what: T-008: eight malformed FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING values, including O-017's four
checks.evidence: PASSED: T-008, EXIT 0 in 40 s. All 8 launches exited -532462766 (0xE0434352) with no report and one hook line. New rows: 'folder1|2|x' → FormatException "the error 'x' is not a whole number". 'folder1|2|18' → ArgumentOutOfRangeException '... (Parameter 'win32Error') Actual value was 18.' '|2|995' → ArgumentException "'' is not one folder's name (Parameter 'folderName')". 'a\b|2|995' → ArgumentException "'a\b' is not one folder's name (Parameter 'folderName')".

checks.what: Each T-008 regex matches only its own refusal line (discrimination)
checks.command: PowerShell: every $bad regex tested against the 8 observed refusal lines plus an 'armed' line
checks.evidence: Rows 0,1,2,4,5,6,7 each match only their own line. Row 3 (error 0, pre-existing from attempt 1, unanchored) matches lines 3 and 5 (error 0 and error 18). All four new rows discriminate. No regex matches the armed line.
63 rule(s) checked against 116 parsed file(s). Every declared rule holds.

checks.what: Full window suite against the published exe (criterion 8)
checks.evidence: EXIT 1 after 937 s. 48 case headers ran (C-001..C-014, O-016, L-001..L-003, B-001..B-008, V-001, P-001, T-001..T-004, T-006, T-007, T-008, K-001..K-003, R-001, S-001..S-009). There was exactly 1 FAIL line: B-006 sub-case 'the second scan fails before any entry (its root is gone)', 'the second scan started (ScanningPanel set Visible)', expected True, actual False. Hook log: 'acted ... ms=797', 'started scanning=False outcome=True', 'ended ... ms=810'. The failure ending landed before the hook sampled 'started'. Every other check in B-006 and all 47 other cases passed, including T-007 (P 'could not be read in full', 355 of 2000 kept). N-001..N-004 not run.

checks.what: B-006 re-run on its own to see whether the failure is repeatable
checks.evidence: Run 1 EXIT 0 in 53 s, run 2 EXIT 0 in 57 s, run 3 EXIT 0 in 52 s: PASSED: B-006 each time. The hook logged 'started scanning=True outcome=False' each time. SL-043's code-review-2.json already records that B-006's ordering 'is now a race and not a guarantee'.

checks.what: A/B of B-006 against uat without SL-082
checks.evidence: Not run. The inference that B-006's failure is unrelated to the slice rests on: src unchanged since attempt 1 (48/48 then), 3/3 alone now, the failing sub-case failing at the root before any listing page, and the recorded SL-043 race.

checks.what: Criterion 9 dormancy (exe run without DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS, with the variable set)
checks.evidence: Not re-run this attempt. Stale scope, and the exe file and src are the same as when attempt 1 measured it (fixture 2,050 files identical with and without the variable; DriverStore file/folder counts and bytesOnDisk identical).
They change this machine's SMB mappings and do not touch the failpoint or the partial-read row. Not run, as in every earlier run on this slice.

checks.what: No stray processes; worktree unmodified; my temp output only
checks.evidence: 0 FsAnalyser.App processes. git status shows only the pre-existing .taad/slices/SL-082 metadata. The 16 folders under %TEMP%\fsa-window-cases all have creation times at or before 11:40:24. My runs started at about 11:41 (T-008), 11:42:10 (All) and after 11:57 (B-006 x3), so none of those folders are mine and I did not touch them. The only file I left is my own log, %TEMP%\sl082-validate2-all.txt.

criteria.criterion: 1. The listing failpoint is armed before the scan starts, when FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING is a well-formed value naming a folder present in the fixture
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this attempt's -Case All run, with src and the exe unchanged since attempt 1, where T-007's log showed 'fail-listing armed p-… page 2 error 995' as the first line, ahead of 'loaded mode=tree'.

criteria.criterion: 2. A bad FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING value (wrong arg count, non-numeric page, page<2, or a Core member reflection cannot find) is refused
criteria.how: T-008 re-run: all 8 values are refused with 0xE0434352, no report, and one refusal line. Now includes the empty-name, path-separator, error-18 and non-numeric-error values O-017 asked for. The missing-member refusal is the NoFailListingMember mutant, caught in attempt 1. Its code is unchanged and it was not re-run.

criteria.criterion: 3. A folder's listing fails partway when it spans at least 2 listing pages and the fault lands on page 2
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this -Case All run: 'P, whose listing failed at its second page, reads 'could not be read in full' ... charges the 355 of 2000 files it kept'.

criteria.criterion: 4. The tree row for a partially-read folder (0 < K < total listed before the fault)
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this run. P's note is 'could not be read in full', it has an expander, and 355 of 2000 are kept.

criteria.criterion: 5. An unrelated sibling folder (Q), scanned in the same pass with no fault armed against it, is unaffected
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this run (Q read in full). The ListingFailsAnyFolder mutant that proves this check bites was run in attempt 1 against unchanged code.

criteria.criterion: 6. A fully denied folder (R, via the existing ACL fixture route) sits next to the partial one
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this run (R 'could not be opened', no expander).

criteria.criterion: 7. Expanding the partial row: the expander is opened before the report is captured
criteria.how: T-007 passed in this run. P's container is opened by the hook's WALK and its 355 child rows are read. The opening is programmatic, through the container, not a mouse or keyboard toggle, and the evidence is tree-row lines, not schema-1 (a deviation declared in attempt 1).

criteria.criterion: 8. The existing WindowCases.ps1 suite still passes after the schema-1 report change
criteria.how: No schema-1 change was made (WindowReport.cs untouched). -Case All: 47 of 48 passed. B-006 failed one timing check once (the failure ending arrived 13 ms after 'acted', before the hook sampled 'started') and passed 3/3 alone. It is a known pre-existing race (SL-043 code review), on a sub-case that fails before any listing page, with src unchanged since attempt 1's 48/48. That B-006 is unrelated is inferred, not A/B-tested against uat.

criteria.criterion: 9. The failpoint stays dormant outside the hook process: the Release single-file published exe run without DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS
criteria.how: Carried from attempt 1, not re-run. It is the same exe file (10:28:05, 139,902,616 bytes) and no src changed since. Attempt 1 measured that the variable without the hook leaves results identical to baseline on a fixture and on real DriverStore, and that the bundle holds no 'FSA_HOOK' string. Fitness re-run now: the rule barring FSA_HOOK_FAIL_LISTING and FailListingOf( in App holds.

obligations.evidence: tests/window/WindowCases.ps1:3053-3056 now feeds 'folder1|2|x', 'folder1|2|18', '|2|995' and 'a\b|2|995', each with an anchored regex that matches only its own refusal line (checked against all 8 observed lines). T-008 re-run: PASSED, EXIT 0. Each new value exits 0xE0434352 with no report and its own reason: FormatException for 'x', ArgumentOutOfRangeException 'Actual value was 18.' for 18, and ArgumentException (Parameter 'folderName') for '' and 'a\b'.
Unchanged since attempt 1's verification: no src diff between cd235ca and HEAD, and T-007 passed again in this -Case All run.

not_reached: No listing ever failed partway because of Windows itself. The 'could not be read in full' row was reached only through the injected failpoint. Spike 2 showed local NTFS cannot produce one as an ordinary user, and spike 4 (SMB loopback) never ran its fault test. That a real mid-listing error takes the same path is inferred from where the failpoint sits, not observed.
The partial row's expander was opened by the hook's WALK through its container, not by a mouse or keyboard toggle on the drawn glyph.

B-006's one failure in the full run was not A/B-tested against uat. That it is a pre-existing harness race unrelated to SL-082 is inferred from the hook log (the ending arrived 13 ms after 'acted'), 3/3 isolated passes, unchanged src, and SL-043's earlier note. A person may want to make B-006's 'second scan started' check tolerate a scan that ends before the hook samples it.
Criterion 9 dormancy was not re-measured this attempt. It is carried from attempt 1 on the same exe file and unchanged src.
N-001..N-004 (-IncludeNetwork) were not run. They change SMB mappings and do not touch this slice's row.
T-008's 0xE0434352 exit on a machine with WER's crash UI enabled: a dialog could hold each of the now 8 launches until the 30 s timeout. Here every launch ended within about a second.
Only this machine's 1920x1080 display at 100% DPI. Other DPIs and screen sizes, and Windows 10, were not tried.
